specialty_focus: Adcock Ingram Critical Care (AICC) manufactures, markets, and distributes life-saving hospital and critical care products . Operating out of its integrated plant in Aeroton, South Africa, it supplies intensive care units, operating theaters, and renal units across both the private and public healthcare sectors.
